name: Mansion-Exterior-View-Primary
logline_subject_info: The grand front entrance of a luxurious mansion, viewed from the position of the assembled press and guests.
visual_desc: LOCATION TYPE: Grand entrance of a luxurious neoclassical palace. PRIMARY DIRECTION (camera faces): North — toward the main doors. NORTH (background / far end): A set of massive, ornate double doors made of dark, polished wood with brass handles, set into the building's facade. The doors are at the top of a wide, four-step stone staircase. The facade wall is a warm yellow stucco. Flanking the entrance are two massive, grey stone columns supporting a second-story balcony with an iron railing. SOUTH (foreground / behind viewer): An open stone-paved courtyard area, empty, where crowds would gather. The ground is clean and well-maintained. EAST (right when facing North): The yellow stucco facade of the mansion continues, with a tall arched window visible. WEST (left when facing North): The yellow facade continues, mirroring the east side with another tall arched window. GROUND: Wide, grey stone steps and paving stones. SKY/ATMOSPHERE: Bright, clear daylight, suggesting a celebratory mid-day event. The scene is empty of people. The building has yellow walls, massive gray columns, and a balcony. The massive double doors are the swing-out type.
video_visual_desc: Wide shot of a luxurious mansion's grand entrance with yellow walls, grey columns, a wide staircase, and massive wooden doors. Bright daylight. Empty.

anchor_points.axes: X = fraction of courtyard width: 0 = West side, 1 = East side. Y = fraction of courtyard depth: 0 = South gate (entrance), 1 = North doors (far side). Z = fraction of height: 0 = ground, 1 = sky. View-To-Entrance (from doors to gate) mirrors X (e.g., West side at x=0.1 becomes frame-right) and reverses Y depth.

zones.label: Entrance Threshold
zones.visual_disposition_hint: Standing on the stone paving at the base of the stairs, centered on the main doors. The stairs and doors are in the immediate background, framed by the west (image-left) and east (image-right) columns. DEPTH: courtyard foreground → stairs mid-ground → main doors background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: Standing on the top step, looking out over the courtyard toward the gate. The west (now frame-right) and east (now frame-left) columns are in the immediate foreground. The courtyard gate is visible in the center background. DEPTH: main doors foreground → courtyard mid-ground → courtyard gate background.

zones.label: Courtyard Center
zones.visual_disposition_hint: Standing in the middle of the open stone courtyard, looking towards the mansion. The entire entrance facade with its doors, columns, and balcony is visible in the background. DEPTH: entrance gate foreground → courtyard mid-ground → mansion facade background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: Standing in the middle of the open stone courtyard, looking towards the gate. The courtyard gate is centered in the background, with the mansion facade behind the camera. DEPTH: mansion facade foreground → courtyard mid-ground → courtyard gate background.

zones.label: Courtyard Gate Area
zones.visual_disposition_hint: Standing just inside the courtyard gate, looking towards the mansion. The gateposts are in the immediate foreground on the image-left and image-right. The mansion facade is visible in the far background across the courtyard. DEPTH: courtyard gate foreground → open courtyard mid-ground → mansion facade background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: Standing near the mansion doors, looking across the courtyard towards the gate. The gate is centered in the background, with its west gatepost on the frame-right and east gatepost on the frame-left. DEPTH: mansion facade foreground → open courtyard mid-ground → courtyard gate background.
